notes.title: Mac version will be released on Sep.13th

tags.feature: 2. [b]More levels[/b], mainly are challenging because all the monsters in these levels can re-spawn, which let players get more bonus;
3. [b]More traps[/b], including chest bomb, saws coming out from walls, bear traps and etc., which are very different from other dungeon crawler game;

4. Useful [b]Statistics[/b], including play time, grids you’ve covered, total amount of money collection, experience gained, monster killed, secret places you’ve explored and the [b]rank[/b] you’ve gained in the game, there are more specific information you’ll get on the map in the game;
5. [b]Player’s guide step by step IN GAME[/b].  You’ll learn how to use torch, fight to monsters, discover secret places and solve puzzles in the game;

6. [b]Much easier magic casting system[/b].  You can choose the way to cast magic spells, which are [b]rune combination system[/b] or just [b]cast the spells directly[/b] in the setting menu.  With the player guide, you can play the game without any problem by choosing direct magic casting system;

7. Fighter and Ranger in the game now have [b]special skill[/b] to do melee attack.  And more, [b]duel wielding[/b] skill, which has been asked frequently in steam community, has been added finally.  The [b]warlord class[/b] is rare in dungeon crawler games, we’ve added fire and dark magic to this class, so the class is [b]unique[/b], which provides more combination for the team and more fun for playing the game;

notes.title: Now we can update the game, build version 2417
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34096850/6797aff82efbb664c86164cca66ae9e5d55fb33d.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34096850/3a8f87e6e28b5e9e7f081b0475a54f8bb253f9e1.png[/img][/url]

[b][u]If you have any question, please post in discussions, not here.[/u][/b]

Last week we've encountered some network connection issues and couldn't upload any file to the server.  Sorry that we didn't update anything during the time.  But now we figured out a way to update the game, so here we go.


We've built a guide inside the game, so you don't have to complain how to split items that can be piled.  Battle now is much more balancing and we fixed some translation errors for Korean.

Difficulty has already been done and you can select it in the beginning menu.  Easy mode removes hunger system for your convenience, but not lowing down the combat of the original build, if you are in the middle of the game and not willing to restart the game.

Hope you'll have fun in this update.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34096850/9634a2c7235b2e9313a3802633154f67e8acbe32.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34096850/087c27848df2577efda774cfce86c15d2e8fe087.jpg[/img]

tags.feature: We've built a guide inside the game, so you don't have to complain how to split items that can be piled.

notes.title: New updates in build 2410
notes.content:
Dear Players,

During last week, we added several features:

Added skill Blade Storm for fighter and sudden attack for ranger.

Blade Storm:  Attacking enemy surrounded, long CD.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34096850/aca90f7f8b0b63acf36547678319e97bf1195aa3.jpg[/img]

Sudden Attack: Attacking enemy ahead and generating a great amount of damage, long CD.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34096850/7ecd340d29cfa4974b94acc41856c1fe6c8b348d.jpg[/img]

Added Difficulty Selection at the beginning.  Only affect the combat, not puzzles.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34096850/1677b40b4440c3b9a32dcb8b6b6c2400d2c49b3f.jpg[/img]

Fixed several bugs including translation errors.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34096850/91c683f56b9620f3c3eb080fd6e2843e50ef97fe.jpg[/img]

We are working day and night, it is hard, but we are happy if you like the game.

Cheers,
HexGameStudio
